messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Angela Park <angela.park@acme-analytics.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-07-19T15:08:00-07:00
Subject: Procurement intake & PO vs Card — Redwood Inference

Hi Angela / Procurement team,

Great to meet you on the call earlier — thanks for the time. Quick recap and a couple of questions so we can get vendor setup moving: 

- Commercial path: Do you expect to pay via PO (net terms) or will this be paid by corporate card? If PO, please confirm who issues POs and the typical net terms (Net 30 / Net 45).
- Marketplace: Are you interested in consuming via AWS Marketplace (we can do consolidated billing) or direct invoice?
- Vendor setup packet: I can kick off our vendor intake (W-9/W-8, vendor form, banking ACH template) — who should I send the packet to?
- Contract timing: any procurement deadlines we should be aware of (renewal window, fiscal close)?

I'll loop in Marissa from our procurement ops to help with paperwork if you want Redwood to submit a vendor packet directly into your vendor portal.

Next steps: if PO, please send sample PO language or a template and the contact for your procurement admin; if card, let me know the billing email and card process.

Attaching a short vendor_setup_packet checklist and our W-9 for your records.

Attachments: vendor_setup_packet.pdf (summary), W-9.pdf

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
D: +1 (415) 555-0192

--
[attachment: vendor_setup_packet.pdf (application/pdf)]
[attachment: W-9.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Angela Park <angela.park@acme-analytics.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acme-analytics.com>
Date: 2026-07-19T17:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Procurement intake & PO vs Card — Redwood Inference

Thanks Dylan — appreciate the clear recap. A few answers below: 

- Payment method: We prefer PO for any SOW or subscription over $10k/month. We typically run Net 30.
- PO owner: Mike O'Neill (procurement) will own the PO issuance and vendor onboarding.
- Marketplace: We generally prefer direct invoicing for invoiced SaaS, but willing to evaluate AWS Marketplace if it simplifies procurement.
- Vendor packet: Please send the vendor packet to procurement@acme-analytics.com and cc mike.oneill@acme-analytics.com. We need a completed vendor_form, W-9, and banking details (ACH) for setup.
- Timeline: Our AP runs vendor setup in ~7-10 business days after receiving complete docs.

We'll look over the attachments and get back if we need any redlines.

Thanks,
Angela Park
Head of Cloud Partnerships | Acme Analytics

Hi Mike / team — Marissa here from Redwood Ops, looping in to own vendor onboarding. Thanks for the details — I'll take these on and aim to push the completed DocuSign and vendor packet into your portal today. A couple quick asks: 

1) Please confirm the exact vendor portal URL we should use to upload (some customers require portal-only uploads): if you have a URL, share it; otherwise we will send DocuSign and email the PDFs.
2) Banking: our ACH form supports both ACH and wire — if you need additional forms (voided check or banking letter), let us know.
3) Marketplace: if you prefer AWS Marketplace, let me know and I'll flag billing differences to our finance team (marketplace invoicing may change payment flows).

Expected timing: once we have the completed forms and portal URL, vendor setup typically takes 5-10 business days on your side. If you need faster turnaround, we can request expedited onboarding.

I'll send DocuSign (vendor setup + W-9) in the next email.

Regards,
